Hi Marta — great to hear from you and thanks for the sample files. Quick answers up front, then a short checklist and a sample header you can share with your AP team.

1) PO stamping vs subject token:
   - Preferred: PO number visible on the invoice PDF (first page) + PO field in the invoice metadata. This gives the cleanest automation for our portal.
   - Fallback: If you must email invoices to invoices@redwood.com, include the PO in the subject as "PO: <PO_NUMBER>" and use the vendor tax ID in the body. Emails without PO tokens are routed to manual queue and have SLA impact.

2) Portal CSV rules:
   - We accept multi-line CSV uploads per invoice, but each CSV file must contain a single invoice_id column value for the invoice to stay atomic. If you have a physical PDF with multiple PO lines, you can either: (a) upload per-invoice CSV files, or (b) use a single PDF plus a matching CSV that references the same invoice_id for line-level parsing.

3) Multi-PO invoices:
   - Best practice: split into separate invoice files per PO if the POs are for different Redwood legal entities. If the POs are under the same legal entity and the invoice clearly lists multiple PO numbers, include all PO numbers in the invoice header and in the invoice_id -> line mapping. Our ingestion validates PO match rules and will flag ambiguous cases.

Checklist (action items for Acme to submit):
- Ensure invoice PDF first page contains: vendor name, vendor tax ID, invoice number, invoice date, total, and PO number(s).
- Include a machine-readable invoice_id in the PDF footer (recommended format: ACME-INV-YYYYMMDD-XXXX).
- For portal CSVs, include these columns (minimum): invoice_id, invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_number, description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, tax_amount, currency, accounting_center.
- Filename convention for emailed fallback: REDWOOD_INV_<vendor_taxid>_<invoice_number>_<date>.ext (example: REDWOOD_INV_123456789_INV1001_20280928.pdf) and subject must contain: "PO: <PO_NUMBER> | Vendor: Acme Supply".
- If you expect regular multi-PO batches, please flag the account in the onboarding form so we can set a relaxed PO-strictness rule during the pilot.

I've attached our onboarding form and a sample CSV header as reference. Also looping in Lauren and Priyom to scope any exceptions (e.g., if Acme needs single-file multi-PO uploads).

Next steps / asks:
- Marta: confirm whether you'll split multi-PO invoices or prefer us to enable the pilot exception.
- Acme AP: send one full example set (PDF + matching CSV) for a multi-PO invoice so our ingestion team can validate mappings.
- We will confirm whether any entity-level PO-splitting is required after ingest test.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
